entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit, your partner in performance. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Karen. How can I help you today?
Hi Karen. I bought the new VeloBand Pulse and it's just not working for me. The pulse reading is all over the place. I don't want to waste time with support, I just want to return it.
Oh, I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with it, but that's **no problem** at all. We can certainly process a return for you.
Really? That's it? I was worried it might be too late.
Not at all! Our policy allows for returns within **90 days** of delivery, so you're well within that window. Let me just pull up your account here... one moment.

Alright, I have your information. And I see you're a VIP member with us! As a thank you for your loyalty, I can get that **return label** sent to your email right now, and I'll also add a $25 credit to your account for your next purchase.
Wow, that's fantastic. I wasn't expecting that. Thank you so much, Karen.
You are very welcome! The email with the label should be in your inbox within the next 5 minutes. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's perfect. You've been a great help.
Happy to assist. Thanks again for calling VeloFit, and have a great day!
